china-1928:p0176_1.rationale: Coast carrying trade between open ports by flag: clearances, tonnage, export and re-export values, export duties and tonnage dues. Shipping is the main subject; re-exports and customs duties are substantial columns.

china-1928:p0177_1.rationale: Inward coast trade by flag: entries, tonnage, Chinese and foreign import values and import duties.

china-1928:p0178_1.rationale: Foreign and coastwise carrying trade by flag, combining tonnage with import, export and coast trade values.

china-1928:p0179_1.rationale: Duties and tonnage dues paid by each flag on foreign and coast trade; customs revenue by nationality of carrying vessels.

china-1928:p0180_1.rationale: Percentage shares of each flag in trips, tonnage, trade and dues revenue. Shipping is the clear subject; other aspects are mixed percentages.

china-1928:p0181_1.rationale: Value of transit trade inwards and outwards at each port, 1925. Transit trade is the explicit subject. The treaty-ports tag is weakly supported, so it is dropped.

china-1928:p0182_1.rationale: Shanghai gross and net trade values for 1922-1925: foreign imports, re-exports of foreign and Chinese goods, and exports of local produce.

china-1928:p0184_1.rationale: Monthly prevalence signs (+, ++, +++) for plague, cholera, smallpox and other communicable diseases by province in 1926. The marks are a graded intensity scale rather than counts, but the table is statistical in intent.

china-1928:p0185_1.rationale: Continuation of monthly communicable-disease prevalence for further provinces, Hongkong and Kansu in 1926.

china-1928:p0187_1.rationale: Monthly communicable-disease prevalence for Shansi, Manchuria, Kweichow and Kwangtung in 1926, with graded plus-sign marks.
